text: dsh-webhook-notifier 是面向 DSH Web 的事件通知插件，可在设置页启用回合完成、审批请求、用户提问、agent 出错或开始运行等通知。它将所选事件字段发送到配置的 Webhook，支持 GET/POST、JSON/表单、预设模板、自定义文本和请求头，并提供测试发送与日志。适合希望把 DSH 活动转发到自有通知服务的用户；需填写 Webhook URL，不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-webhook-notifier sends DSH Web event alerts to a webhook. Enable turn, approval, question, error, or agent-start notifications. Choose GET or POST, JSON or form data, preset fields or custom text; add headers, test delivery, and view logs. Requires a webhook URL; no extra API key.
想把 DSH 回合完成和运行状态通知推送到自己的 Webhook。
DSH 出错、有人提问或需要审批时，能不能自动发 HTTP 通知？
I want configurable HTTP alerts for DSH events sent to my webhook.
dsh-webhook-notifier 的功能「事件 Webhook 通知」：分别启用 DSH 回合完成、审批请求、提问、出错或开始运行等事件，并将所选字段通过 GET/POST 发送到配置的 Webhook。支持 JSON 或表单格式。
dsh-webhook-notifier 的功能「通知配置与测试日志」：在 DSH Web 设置面板配置触发项、请求方式、URL、字段模板和请求头；可发起测试请求并查看发送日志及请求结果。
dsh-webhook-notifier 使用前须知：启用通知后，所选事件中已配置的字段（可包括会话标识、用户消息或助手回复）会随 HTTP 请求发送到你填写的 Webhook 地址；可在配置中决定发送哪些字段。

dsh-webhook-notifier README · dsh-webhook-notifier：> DSH event-notification plugin: send HTTP notifications to a webhook when specified events occur.

[](LICENSE)
**English** · [中文](README.zh.md)

**Can be used together with the [Desktop Pet](https://github.com/masknull/dsh-pet-standalone) project** — e.g. push a notification to your desktop pet when a turn completes.

dsh-webhook-notifier README · Features：- 🔔 **5 trigger scenarios** (each independently toggleable in settings):
  - AI turn completed
  - Approval requested (approval)
  - AI asks a question
  - AI errored
  - AI started running
- 🌐 **HTTP requests**: `GET` / `POST`, body as `JSON` / `Form`
- 📦 **Two payload modes**:
  - **Preset fields**: toggle fields and write templates (e.g. `{"session":"{{sessionName}}"}`)
  - **Custom text**: always sent as the `msg` parameter, free-form content
- 🏷️ **Always sends `type` + `type_cn`**: the message kind in English and Chinese
- 🔧 **Custom headers**: add arbitrary header key/value pairs
- 🔍 **Test send**: verify connectivity with one click
- 📜 **Send log**: each entry expandable to inspect full request content, response, and errors
- 💾 **Persistent config**: stored in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`, survives restarts

dsh-webhook-notifier README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:masknull/dsh-webhook-notifier
```

**Restart `dsh web`** after installing.

dsh-webhook-notifier README · Usage：1. Open **Settings → Webhook Notifier**
2. Turn on the **Webhook 通知** switch
3. Configure **Request**: method, URL, payload mode, headers
4. Tick the **trigger scenarios** (which events send notifications)
5. Fill the payload in **Preset Fields** or **Custom Text**
6. Click **Test Send** to verify, then **Save**
dsh-webhook-notifier README · Placeholders：Templates support the following placeholders (`{{ }}` wrapped, distinct from JSON `{}`):

dsh-webhook-notifier README · Placeholders：| Placeholder | Description |
|-------------|-------------|
| `{{type}}` | Message type, always sent (e.g. `turnComplete`) |
| `{{type_cn}}` | Message type in Chinese, always sent (e.g. `回合完成`) |
| `{{sessionId}}` | Session ID |
| `{{sessionName}}` | Session title |
| `{{turn}}` | Turn number |
| `{{time}}` | Current time (UTC+8) |
| `{{trigger}}` | Trigger scenario |
| `{{toolName}}` | Tool name (approval requests) |
| `{{reason}}` | Reason (approval requests) |
| `{{error}}` | Error message (AI errored) |
| `{{question}}` | Question text (AI asks) |
| `{{status}}` | Status (agent running) |
| `{{userMessage}}` | Latest user message |
| `{{assistantMessage}}` | Latest AI reply |
| `{{createdAt}}` | Session creation time |

dsh-webhook-notifier README · Send Examples：**POST + JSON (preset fields):**
```json
{"type":"turnComplete","type_cn":"回合完成","sessionId":"s1","sessionName":"测试会话"}
```

**POST + JSON (custom text → `msg`):**
```json
{"msg":"任务【测试会话】回合完成","type":"turnComplete","type_cn":"回合完成"}
```

**GET:** `https://example.com/hook?type=turnComplete&type_cn=回合完成&sessionId=s1`
dsh-webhook-notifier README · Companion Projects：- [Desktop Pet](https://github.com/masknull/dsh-pet-standalone): surface notifications on your desktop pet to monitor DSH activity in real time.

dsh-webhook-notifier README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-webhook-notifier
```

Restart `dsh web`. Config remains in `settings.yaml` (remove the fields manually to fully purge).
